raw_gltf_spherical_interpolation.policy: Raw GLB LINEAR rotations use quaternion SLERP; other transforms use linear interpolation. Root and scale channels are dropped as in Player. Heights are glTF world Y. Actual POSITION, JOINTS_0, WEIGHTS_0 and inverse bind matrices are evaluated.
